answer: Each identity registers one cedar stand in the canyon timber registry, locks 70, and files cedar readings at three milestones. A canyon auditor replays readings on the timber table; readings off by over 5% or reused bands burn the bond. Each filing costs 35: 1,000 fakes pay 35,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. One forester key signs at most five stands per epoch, killing rented-forester rings. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps the bond.
